independent_evidence_inspected: continuation-evidence/native/imageio-status-probe-r1/measurement.json (60 measured rows; complete and truncated samples for five formats across three decoder modes)
Lumina R6 test-summary.json and two NSFileWrapper export crash reports (previously inspected for separate UI/export correction)
findings: No blocking source defect found in bounded container validation, Swift control flow, integer conversions, WAL setup, or controller filename assertions.
PNG reads are bounded before offsets; chunk CRC includes type and payload, IEND and exact framing required, valid unknown chunks remain supported.
JPEG walks actual marker/segment boundaries and entropy transitions, skips APP payload EOIs, retains restart, TEM, DNL and multi-scan handling; this is not a complete entropy validator.

GIF local/global table spans and extension/image data sub-blocks are bounded, with an image and a trailer required. A non-image palette-only GIF already cannot satisfy the existing decoded-photo gate.
HEIF-family top-level box sizes are checked against remaining bytes before conversion to Int. Size-zero boxes retain legitimate EOF semantics; nested item extents are not comprehensively checked.
Other ImageIO-supported historical types retain the original bounds and thumbnail/decode gate; no new restrictive format allowlist or recompression.
Deadline/cancellation checks remain within long parser loops and original file, total-photo, frame, dimension and pixel limits remain unchanged.

SQLite documentation explicitly makes output counters undefined for nil/empty database names. Explicit main plus pager read corrects the fixture while retaining the strict logFrames > copiedFrames assertion.
Actual normal and raw controller tests now inspect Transferable.suggestedFilename as well as dialog exportFilename; filename enum alone is not treated as native-picker proof.
limits: R7 79-case suite plus archive required; source review cannot prove native export, language, large text, or physical-device behavior.
Framing plus bounded decoder work is not proof against every corrupt entropy stream or every HEIF item-extent problem.
source_change_by_reviewer: Applied exact root-owned two-file patch after review; no modifications to its bytes.
